scenes.body: Five moments every tradie knows. Which one's you?
Painters, sparkies, gutter jobs. Both hands busy, phone in the back pocket.
Walking a pergola job with the homeowner. Answering now looks rude to the person in front of you.
Landscapers and gardeners. You won't hear it ring, let alone answer it.
Kids in the car, a line of traffic. Not the time to talk about a blocked drain.
It asks what they need, then sends you a clear job summary. You call back ready.

scenes.text: Missed the call? *Still call back ready.*
